response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with strong systems and tooling instincts (low-latency D services, IDE component work at National Instruments, open-source test tooling), but the core requirements of this role — deep Java/Kotlin and JVM expertise plus solid Spring/enterprise framework experience — are essentially absent from his profile. Java appears only peripherally (robotic arms, device orchestration at Altom, 2016–2018), Kotlin and Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate not at all, and his last decade has been predominantly TypeScript/Node/D web and platform work. The transferable strengths (language tooling interest, test frameworks, C/C++ IDE internals) are real but would require a long ramp on the JVM ecosystem this product is built around.
strengths: Built IDE internals in C/C++ for LabWindows/CVI
Authored language tooling: test runner and assertion libraries
Broad, deep experience across low-latency and large-scale systems
concerns: No demonstrated Kotlin or Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate experience
Java exposure is minimal and ~8 years stale
Recent work is TypeScript/Node web, not JVM tooling
